content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to edit an existing task's title, description, priority and Due Date","so_that":"I can keep my task list accurate after plans change","business_description":"Users can change the editable fields of a task they have already created. Edits use the same validation rules as task creation: the title must be non-empty and no longer than 100 characters, and the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date. Every saved edit updates the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message after each update and never shows an update as successful before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can correct or update tasks without deleting and recreating them, which keeps task history and dates intact and keeps the task list consistent with what is stored.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to another non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, priority and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the task keeps its previous title, and the form shows the error message 'Title is mandatory'"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task, the form does not show the task as updated, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request that fails with a database error on the backend","when":"The backend writes the update to the database and the write fails","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task keeps its previous values including the Last Updated Date, and the frontend shows an error message instead of a success message"}],"edge_cases":["A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed, because the rule rejects only dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A title that contains only spaces is not defined in the PRD; whether it counts as empty is an open question.","An update request for a task ID that no longer exists returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","A rejected update leaves the Last Updated Date unchanged.","The PRD does not state whether a Creation Date can be edited; this story does not allow it, since the editable fields are Title, Description, Priority and Due Date.","The PRD does not state how two simultaneous edits of the same task are resolved; this is an open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} stores changed Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and sets the Last Updated Date on each successful update.","Validation for title (non-empty, 100 characters or fewer) and Due Date (not earlier than Creation Date) matches the create rules.","Error responses for Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory fields and internal or database errors are returned and tested.","The edit form is pre-filled with the existing values and reuses the create form.","The frontend shows a success message only after a success response and an error message after a failure, and does not change the list on failure.","The test suite covers the update paths listed in the acceptance criteria and passes."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update editable task fields","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add a PUT endpoint that updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date of an existing task. Apply the same title and Due Date validation as create, return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, return invalid input for values outside the allowed Priority list, and return a server error for database failures.
